Yizhi Zhao

M.Sc. student at EPFL · Project student at VITA Lab

I work on end-to-end autonomous driving, world models, and reinforcement learning. At VITA Lab, my current project studies how driving models generalize across geographic environments.

I'm pursuing an M.Sc. in Civil Engineering at EPFL, specializing in Transportation and Mobility, with a minor in Data Science. Before that, I studied Traffic Engineering at Southeast University. In summer 2026, I interned at Bosch in Shanghai, working on flow matching planners and RL post-training.
